title: Warm Turkish Goat Doner Kebab
description: A fermented and shattering solo dinner Turkish dish featuring goat meat, flambe, and halal friendly ingredients, served in a kebab doner form.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced goat meat to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Remove the meat from the marinade and cook in the preheated skillet for 5 minutes per side.
Transfer the cooked meat to a cutting board and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Slice the meat into thin strips.
Heat the vegetable oil in the same skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced meat to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Flambe the meat with a small amount of oil and serve hot.
Serve the doner kebab in a warm pita bread with your choice of toppings.
